chunks: Say: Act, and God will see your conduct, and so will His Apostle and the faithful; for you will in the end go back to Him, who knows the unknown and the known, who will tell you of what you were doing.

key_terms.فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ: He will inform you (on the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does Surah At-Tawbah say about the observation of human deeds by God and the believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the triad of 'God, His Messenger, and the Believers' highlights the comprehensive surveillance of deeds, where the Imams, as the perfect believers, serve as the ultimate witnesses to the Prophet's teachings. This verse underscores the concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen) belonging primarily to Allah, yet manifesting through the Prophet and the faithful, reinforcing the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a reminder that worldly observation is merely a precursor to the final, divine accounting on the Day of Resurrection.
